links.outcome: Consistency of supervised model gains across held-out provinces
links.effect: Supervised gains held across all nine held-out provinces, including every top-1 comparison and nearly every macro F1 and CSMF comparison.
links.quote: Supervised gains held across all nine held-out provinces, including every top-1 comparison and nearly every macro F1 and CSMF comparison.

links.outcome: Supervised pipelines versus incumbent InSilicoVA on same data, accuracy
links.effect: Every supervised pipeline improved on InSilicoVA by 8.5–15.9 percentage points in top-1 accuracy and 3.5–7.1 in CSMF accuracy.
links.quote: Every supervised pipeline improved on InSilicoVA by 8.5–15.9 percentage points in top-1 accuracy and 3.5–7.1 in cause-specific mortality fraction (CSMF) accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Combining free-text narratives with structured questionnaire responses via multimodal fusion for cause-of-death assignment

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks multimodal and language model pipelines against standard operational baselines (InSilicoVA) on retrospective verbal autopsy records to determine cause of death; it focuses on model architecture comparisons and does not evaluate a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
